title: Captain Robert Bartlett and Lt. Commander Alexander Forbes aboard the Morrissey, 1943
creator: Sherman Wengerd
description: Captain Robert Bartlett and Dr. Alexander Forbes stand together on the deck of the schooner Effie M. Morrissey during the 1943 hydrographic survey that supplied Crystal Two.

title: Major John Crowell, and the Crystal Two advance base on Crowell Island
creator: Sherman Wengerd
description: A portrait of Major John T. Crowell, commander of the 1941-42 party that wintered over, alongside an aerial photograph of the Crystal Two advance base on Crowell Island with flat ground to the east eyed as a possible airstrip.

title: Nakasuk, who supplied and guided the Crystal Two winter party, 1943
creator: Sherman Wengerd
description: Nakasuk, an Inuk who camped near the advance base and became Major Crowell's guide and provisioner through the winter of 1941-42, paddling a kayak in 1943.

title: Maps of Frobisher Bay and the Cincinnati Press Channel showing the Crystal Two sites
creator: R.V. Eno / Alexander Forbes survey
description: Two modern reference maps: Frobisher Bay with the Crystal Two airbase at Koojesse Inlet marked, and a detailed chart of the Cincinnati Press Channel showing the Crowell Island advance base and the 1943 shipping channel through the Barrier Islands.

title: Izoc (Crystal Two) general site plan, 1943, showing the two runways
creator: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
description: A wartime engineering site plan of the Crystal Two airfield, code-named Izoc, showing the paved and gravel runways, approach zones, hangar and radio mast against the surveyed contours of the Koojesse Inlet site.
